releases.body:
[diff](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/compare/3.9.10...3.10.0)

🔗 [Prettier 3.10: New Flow syntax, new JavaScript syntax, and new plugin powered by Yuku](https://prettier.io/blog/2026/11/11/3.10.0)

- Markdown: Update `micromark-extension-gfm-table` to fix the table parse issue on performance ([#20266](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/20266) by [@fisker](https://github.com/fisker))

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.9.10/CHANGELOG.md#3910)

- Markdown: Fix text with `$` been incorrectly parsed as math syntax ([#20140](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/20140) by [@fisker](https://github.com/fisker))


🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.9.9/CHANGELOG.md#399)

- Markdown: Don't let Liquid objects interrupt paragraphs ([#20087](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/20087) by [@seiyab](https://github.com/seiyab))


🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.9.8/CHANGELOG.md#398)

- Support Angular 22.2
- Fix regressions in v3.9

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.9.7/CHANGELOG.md#397)

## What's Changed

* Preserve quotes for methods named `new` (https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19621 by [@kovsu](https://github.com/kovsu))
* Support `import defer` in `typescript` parser (https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19624, https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19675 by [@fisker](https://github.com/fisker))
* Added a new official plugin [`@prettier/plugin-yuku` 🚀](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/tree/3.9.6/packages/plugin-yuku) (https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19628, https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19629 by [@fisker](https://github.com/fisker))


🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.9.6/CHANGELOG.md#396)

- Angular: Format `@content(name)` -> `@content (name)` to align with other block syntax ([#19499](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19499) by [@fisker](https://github.com/fisker))

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.9.4/CHANGELOG.md#394)

- Markdown: Fix unexpected removal of characters in liquid syntax (https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19489 by [@seiyab](https://github.com/seiyab))
- TypeScript: Allow decorators to be used with declare on class fields (https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19492 by [@evoactivity](https://github.com/evoactivity))

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.9.3/CHANGELOG.md#393)

- CLI: Fix ignored file has been cached incorrectly ([#19483](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19483) by [@kovsu](https://github.com/kovsu))

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.9.1/CHANGELOG.md#391)

- Fix Flow variance annotation print ([#19022](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19022) by [@marcoww6](https://github.com/marcoww6))


🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.8.5/CHANGELOG.md#385)

- Markdown: Fix blank lines between list items and nested sub-lists being removed in Markdown/MDX (https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/17746 by [@byplayer](https://github.com/byplayer))

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.8.4/CHANGELOG.md#384)

- SCSS: Prevent trailing comma in `if()` function (https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18471 by [@kovsu](https://github.com/kovsu))


🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/3.8.3/CHANGELOG.md#383)

- Include available `printers` in plugin type declarations ([#18706](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18706) by [@porada](https://github.com/porada))

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#381)

- Support Angular v21.1

[diff](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/compare/3.7.4...3.8.0)

🔗 [Release note "Prettier 3.8: Support for Angular v21.1"](https://prettier.io/blog/2026/01/14/3.8.0)

## What's Changed

* Fix comment in union type gets duplicated by @fisker in https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18393
* Fix unstable comment print in union type by @fisker in https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18395
* Avoid quote around LWC interpolations by @kovsu in https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18383

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#374)

## What's Changed

* Fix `prettier.getFileInfo()` change that breaks VSCode extension by @fisker in https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18375


🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#373)

## What's Changed

* Fix string print when switching quotes by @fisker in https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18351
* Preserve quote for embedded HTML attribute values by @kovsu in https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18352
* Fix comment in empty type literal by @fisker in https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18364

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#372)

- Fix performance regression in doc printer ([#18342](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/18342) by [@fisker](https://github.com/fisker))

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#371)

## What's Changed
* Add missing blank line around code block by @fisker in https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/17675

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#362)

- Fix "Warning: File descriptor 39 closed but not opened in unmanaged mode" error when running `--experimental-cli`

🔗 [Changelog](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#361)

[diff](https://github.com/prettier/prettier/compare/3.5.3...3.6.0)

🔗 [Release note "Prettier 3.6: Experimental fast CLI and new OXC and Hermes plugins!"](https://prettier.io/blog/2025/06/23/3.6.0)

This version is a republished version of v2.8.7.
A bad version was accidentally published and [it can't be unpublished](https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/1686), apologies for the churn.
